name: Prompt Injection (per-block cond)
plain: Replaces cross-attention context at specified blocks with another conditioning, so a block group gets a different prompt, within a sigma window. This builds a tensor with the first cond plus the injected cond multiplied by weight.
math: If σ in window and block in dict: c = context[0]; b = injected.repeat; out = stack(c,b)·weight; repeat by batch·weight again; return q, out, out.

props.architectures: SDXL and SD1.5 block names (separate nodes)

label: from code
surprise: Weight is applied twice in lines 24 and 25, so the effective multiplier is weight², and the first context chunk is used regardless of cond or uncond ordering.
